proposal.quote: Bonnet said that he thought the moment was also propitious for the initiation of immediate conversations with Germany on financial, economic, and disarmament questions.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: This ministerial statement shows French policy seeking a negotiated settlement with Germany, meeting the appease condition of policy seeking a settlement.
